// ClassifierTests.cs
// Part 3 (Wednesday). Rename this file to ClassifierTests.cs when the lab says so.
// Do not edit this file.

using Line3.Monitor;

namespace Line3.Monitor.Tests;

public class ClassifierTests
{
    [Theory]
    [InlineData(null, Level.Missing)]
    [InlineData(199.0, Level.Normal)]
    [InlineData(214.9, Level.Normal)]
    [InlineData(215.0, Level.Warning)]
    [InlineData(239.9, Level.Warning)]
    [InlineData(240.0, Level.Alarm)]
    [InlineData(9999.0, Level.Alarm)]
    public void P3_01_classify_uses_the_limits_in_the_right_order(double? value, Level expected)
    {
        var reading = new Reading("oven-temp", value, 1);
        Assert.Equal(expected, Classifier.Classify(reading, warnAt: 215, alarmAt: 240));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(240, 215)]
    [InlineData(215, 215)]
    public void P3_02_the_warning_limit_must_be_below_the_alarm_limit(double warnAt, double alarmAt)
    {
        var reading = new Reading("oven-temp", 200, 1);
        Assert.ThrowsAny<ArgumentException>(() => Classifier.Classify(reading, warnAt, alarmAt));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(Level.Missing, "MISSING")]
    [InlineData(Level.Normal, "ok")]
    [InlineData(Level.Warning, "WARNING")]
    [InlineData(Level.Alarm, "ALARM")]
    public void P3_03_every_level_has_a_label(Level level, string expected)
    {
        Assert.Equal(expected, Classifier.Label(level));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void P3_04_a_level_outside_the_enum_is_refused()
    {
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => Classifier.Label((Level)42));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void P3_05_the_monitor_classifies_a_whole_source()
    {
        IReadingSource source = new LogLineSource("pasted log",
            new[] { "oven-temp,212.0", "oven-temp,x", "oven-temp,221.5", "oven-temp,247.0" });
        IReadOnlyList<Level> levels = ShiftMonitor.Levels(source, warnAt: 215, alarmAt: 240);
        Assert.Equal(new[] { Level.Normal, Level.Missing, Level.Warning, Level.Alarm }, levels);
    }
}
